title: LA to San Francisco
summary: I-5 up the San Joaquin Valley, then I-580 over Altamont into the East Bay. The verified stops are the ones whose primary charger was on the network's own locator. Town searches for this corridor were completed from the DOE California file.
startNote: Mileage starts at I-5 exit 164 (SR-14, mile 162.24) and ends at I-580 exit 48 (El Charro Road, mile 48.24). I-5 from SR-14 to the I-580 junction is 446.35 − 162.24 = 284.11 miles. I-580 from its east end at mile 81.12 back to exit 48 is 32.88 miles. Total 316.99, shown as 317. The I-580/I-680 exit in Dublin has no milepost in the exit list, so it is not the endpoint.

tips.text: Tejon Pass is 4,144 ft and drops to 1,499 ft at Grapevine. Caltrans may close this grade in snow instead of running a chain control.
Altamont Pass on I-580 is 1,009 ft, on the same exit list as the Grant Line and El Charro miles.

The Coalinga town-center search (10 miles) on October 14, 2026 returned no public DC fast sites. The Harris Ranch search, 8 miles around the ranch, was completed from the DOE state file on October 15, 2026. Those sites are listed on the Kettleman stop.

The Firebaugh town search and the Tracy search were completed from the DOE California file on October 15, 2026. Sites inside those search radii are on those stops. Ones not opened on a network locator stay unverified.

arrival: Dublin and San Francisco city charging are not in this guide. The last stop is the Livermore outlets at I-580 exit 48.
